svg.title: Sizing a plated through-hole and its pad from the lead
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale, three steps. One: measure the lead; a round lead across its diameter, a rectangular lead corner to corner. Two: the hole is the largest lead diameter plus 0.25 mm, so a 0.5 mm lead needs a 0.75 mm hole. Three: the pad is the hole plus twice (0.05 mm minimum annular ring plus 0.3 mm allowance), so a 0.75 mm hole gets a 1.45 mm pad.

g.text: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
IPC density level A (least dense, easiest to build).
Levels B and C use smaller margins (PCB-DFA-037).
